string.text: Hehe, sorry to keep you waiting. Leave the rest to me!
So your name is "Lenna" now? Glad to have you here!
Hmm, hmm, hmm~ Good morning, Commander-Hm? Me? I'm heading off to check in with Leva next! Ehee hee...
Hah? Commander, look, over there! ...(smooch) Hehe, I meant that this time. Didn't expect that, huh?
Huh? There's still work...? No way... Alright, let's get it done quickly!
Lenna, enough for today. Please head back to base.
